title: `landing-operations.md`'s MERGED paragraph implies closed cards keep their `pm:*` label, which the newly codified strip-on-close convention contradicts
body:
Filed unassigned by the dev seat that codified the strip-on-close convention (PR #12906). Small, but it is a protocol document disagreeing with another protocol document about a rule a patrol now enforces.

## The two sentences

PR #12906 adds one sentence to `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md`'s label-discipline section:

> 关闭即摘 `pm:*` 状态标(与关单同一笔;`domain:*`/类型标签留下 —— 归属不是状态)。

`references/landing-operations.md` section B still says, of the same moment:

> 确认 MERGED 的同一动作里给 `Part of` 卡收口(`Fixes` 卡 GitHub 代关、**标签随卡离开在飞视图**)

The parenthetical is the older reading: a `Fixes` card is auto-closed by GitHub, and its `pm:*` label is treated as leaving the in-flight view *with the card* — true only because the inventory queries filter `is:open`. Under the codified convention the label does not merely stop being counted, it is **stripped**, and the closed-card patrol row (H22) reports it when it is not.

So the landing paragraph now describes the `Part of` case correctly (strip the label, comment, one action) while implying the `Fixes` case needs no label write at all — which is exactly the half the convention just closed.

## Why it is not a rider on #12906

It is a second file, outside that PR's declared file surface, and the fix is a judgement rather than a mechanical respelling: the parenthetical is *explaining why the in-flight view stays honest*, and that explanation is still partly true. Whoever takes it has to decide whether to correct it, delete it as now-redundant, or keep it and add the strip step — and `landing-operations.md` is governed and ratcheted, so a net-0 edit with a cut ledger is needed either way.

## Scope note

⛔ Not a request to backfill labels on already-closed cards. The patrol's new dated closure floor means historical closures are out of scope by construction; this is only about what the document tells the next seat to do at the next merge.

Refs: PR #12906 (the convention sentence) · objectstack-ai/objectui#5985 (the ruling it executes)
